new_candidates.body:
### The feature, motivation and pitch

Mirror mesh, inertia, geom, and joint elements when a frame has negative scale. This allows mirror-symmetric subtrees to only be authored once.

Algorithm sketch: 
1) propagate frame transform to tree coordinate systems, leaving left-hand csys
2) for each left-hand csys, apply a heuristic (e.g. flip y coordinate) to produce a right-hand csys, and apply the inverse to all data referencing that csys so that geometry and inertia keep the frame's mirror

Rotation joints need an additional heuristic to decide whether positive joint velocity produces mirrored motion, or if the axis vector is simply mirrored
